$meta.role: Values the design states as a rule but never tokenised. Each entry names the decision that supplied it and whether it still awaits design-owner sign-off.
$meta.rule: An entry may exist here only when the design states the value explicitly in prose and provides no token to carry it. Nothing may be filled from UI convention (AC13). Anything the design has genuinely not decided stays blocked in design-manifest.json instead.

tokens.name: focus.ring.color
tokens.meaning: Focus ring colour. Emitted as a reference rather than a literal so the ring follows the theme — accent.default is #2f6b52 light and #6ab894 dark.
tokens.statedBy: Foundations §16: "A 2px accent ring with a 2px offset on every focusable element, never removed." §10.11 names accent.default as the ring colour.

tokens.statedBy: Foundations §16: "A 2px accent ring with a 2px offset on every focusable element, never removed."

tokens.name: focus.ring.offset
tokens.meaning: Gap between the focused element's edge and the ring.
